<!-- version: 2.59.0 -->
This release is for households that were not fully served by their own language. Greek, Hungarian and Vietnamese have been available as interface languages for a while, but none of them had a matching region, so anyone choosing them landed on "Custom" and had to set currency, date format and time format one by one. All three now come with the right combination already filled in, taken from the conventions of the language itself rather than assumed - Greek households get a 12-hour clock, Hungarian ones the year-first date they actually write.

Vietnamese households also get their currency back. The dong had been selectable once and was lost when the currency list was consolidated some months ago, which meant the app could be used in Vietnamese but not in Vietnamese money. It is in the picker again, alongside the 56 currencies that were already there.

If you sign in through single sign-on and have switched off password sign-in, the login page no longer offers a guest entrance your household cannot use. That button exists for people outside the household who share expenses with you, such as a neighbour settling a bill, and it stays for households that have such guests. Everyone else saw a way in that led nowhere, which understandably looked like a gap in a door they had just locked.

The update needs nothing from you and applies no database change.

Full release notes are available at https://github.com/ulsklyc/yuvomi/releases/tag/v2.59.0
